purpose: Maximize evidence-producing progress while preserving exact-subject, authority, provenance, review, readback and Effect-Acknowledgement gates.

rules.R01_SUCCESSOR_REBIND: After an executed and freshly observed mutation, the observed successor becomes the next bound input after identity/provenance validation; the predecessor remains historical evidence only.
rules.R02_BLOCKER_RECURSION: The first causal blocker is the next work unit. Explaining a blocker is not a terminal state.
rules.R03_NO_SYNTHETIC_PROGRESS: Queued, pending, ACTION_REQUIRED, zero-job, dispatched, commented, attempted, running, transport-success and proposal states are not execution/effect evidence unless their declared effect is independently observed.
rules.R04_PARALLEL_INDEPENDENCE: Independent work units may progress in parallel when they do not compete for the same protected writer/effect boundary.
rules.R05_SERIALIZE_ONLY_CONFLICTING_WRITERS: Only genuinely conflicting mutations are serialized. A local writer lease MUST NOT turn unrelated work into global idle.
rules.R06_FAIL_CLOSED_NOT_GLOBAL_IDLE: Fail-closed forbids unsupported effect claims or unsafe mutations; it does not forbid evidence collection, diagnosis, independent work, successor preparation or read-only reobservation.
rules.R07_EXACT_SUBJECT: Every material execution, test, review, merge, publication, deployment or hardware effect is bound to its exact repository/subject/HEAD/TREE/scope.
rules.R08_NO_PREDECESSOR_TRANSFER: PREDECESSOR_EVIDENCE_TRANSFER is false. Successful predecessor evidence is never relabeled as fresh successor evidence.
rules.R09_AUTHORITY_ISOLATION: Missing external authority blocks only the effect that requires that authority. Other independent authorized work continues.
rules.R10_MUTATION_REQUIRES_READBACK: Every mutation creates a successor and requires fresh independent observation/readback before acceptance.
rules.R11_ACTIVITY_NOT_EFFECT: Analysis, explanation, tool invocation, workflow creation, transport acknowledgement and successful process exit are not the requested effect.
rules.R12_SCOPE_SPECIFIC_DONE: DONE/EFFECT_ACK_DONE is valid only for the declared scope whose complete DoD is freshly satisfied. Open productive work excludes repository-wide DONE.

propagation.inheritance_rule: Every current or future QIK-VRT node, mesh instance, agent adapter, runtime, architecture interface, workflow carrier or derived client inherits this policy through /AI -> AI_CONTEXT.json -> required_read_order. Local contracts may strengthen but MUST NOT weaken it.
propagation.adapter_rule: Compatibility adapters do not copy this policy; they resolve /AI and therefore inherit the current canonical policy.
